scope: The computable rules of the Act as in the PCO's version as at 1 December 2025, from the text converted from the PCO XML: ss 2 (working day), 5, 7, 8, 18-30, 48, 49A-49B, 50-66, 66D, 66R-66X, 77(5), 108(7), 109-109C, 136, 136A. The converted text lost Schedules 1A and 1B (inputs) and the s 56B(5) formula (read as stated in BRIEF.md).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-16 (tests-independent.l4, 246 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read). It found 3 disagreements, all resolved in its favour (the s 24 12-month rule excludes the anniversary; s 56C same-day service of withdrawal notices); the encoder's tests that encoded the rejected reading were changed and marked. The pipeline has not been run.
